name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=field/battle intro). Descriptor accurately captures both responsibilities: places a contiguous runtime_char range (+1 optional extra char) at fixed map positions/facings (chars), and resets the battle view-window + cursor origin (camera), used in chapter cutscene->battle intro transitions. No address residue.
purpose: Chapter cutscene->battle intro helper: place a contiguous range of runtime-chars (plus one optional extra char) at fixed map positions and facings, reset the battle camera/cursor origin and anim phase, then do one composite-with-fade reveal of the new arrangement.
logic_summary: Fade palette to black (hide repositioning). Clear all chars' acted flag. Loop char_start..char_end inclusive: pChar = runtime_char_array_ptr + idx; set pos_x/pos_y from per-char byte tables at (idx + pX_byte_array)/(idx + pY_byte_array); facing = (sprite_facing_fixed_or_array < 4) ? that fixed value : per-char facing byte at (idx + sprite_facing_fixed_or_array); store into pChar->sprite_state[1]. If extra_char_idx != 0, place that one char from extra_x/extra_y/extra_facing (low byte each). Reset battle_anim_phase=0; set view-window origin x/y and cursor world x/y both to origin_x/origin_y; zero cursor screen x/y. composite_battle_frame(1); fade palette in; delay 200 ms. (Body tail-jumps into fd2_composite_battle_frame_zero's shared register-restore+RET epilogue at 0x22BBE; semantically a plain return.)
